recommended_minimal_design: Fresh batch-local exact native/CAD/provenance snapshots and group/connectivity indexes can amortize repeated invariant checks. Keep immutable internal tuples/frozensets, copy public mutable results, and retain duplicates/ambiguity rather than collapsing names with a last-wins dictionary.

MeshSetsGetter.get_constraints_rigidbody_nodes is a natural RBE batch seam. Gather pending rows/conflict nodes, perform end checks, then publish; do not retain snapshot state on a reused getter. Check existing cached getter tables against current native input rather than trusting them.
Ordinary rigid_body.validation_diagnostics must continue to use generic owned-reference resolution. The stricter connector port rank/solid-domain function must not replace it merely to share a cache.

Writer port state may be local to write_solver_input, with unconditional finally cleanup exactly as now. Public direct emitter calls after success or error must create fresh state. prepare_request must create its own independent request-local context.

For AccountingBody rows, _get_solid_reference_group_sets already accepts multiple selectors. One request-local call or equivalent private index can resolve all active selectors in original row order while retaining per-selector shape/domain/ownership checks. Fence references and provenance before any .accounting publication.

noninterchangeable_validation_contracts.risk: Generic ownership accepts an exact canonical OR legacy geometry fingerprint; solid/material group selection requires the exact canonical signature. A shared already-validated flag would broaden the solid/material contract.
noninterchangeable_validation_contracts.requirement: Share computed facts if useful, not caller acceptance decisions. Preserve canonical-only solid checks, legacy generic checks and their current errors.

noninterchangeable_validation_contracts.risk: The original supplied-mesh/owner entry comparison sorts group(name,type,members) tuples and does not require matching native group IDs/order. Existing Contact context instead requires exact group-ID/order equality. Reusing that entry rule everywhere can reject previously accepted supplied meshes.
noninterchangeable_validation_contracts.requirement: Distinguish established supplied-owner equivalence on entry from exact within-batch no-change fencing. Do not accidentally add a new rejection domain through helper reuse.

noninterchangeable_validation_contracts.risk: No provenance and certain non-solid selections intentionally return legacy fallbacks. An unconditional owned snapshot can fail before those fallbacks are selected.
noninterchangeable_validation_contracts.requirement: Keep no-provenance, non-solid/generic RBE and imported-mesh behavior at the existing interface; do not assume every solid-containing mesh is qualified provenance.

lifetime_and_publication_hazards: A mesh/CAD snapshot does not capture each body's References, AccountingBody, section reference or Analysis.Group order. Capture those per batch; cached regions keyed only by body/subname cannot validate a changed selector on their own.

Exact native nodes/connectivity/group data can mutate without document property revision. Preserve raw ordered snapshots, stale cached-getter checks and entry/end comparisons, including same-count edits and formerly empty/unresolved group members. A native mesh copy may omit data and is not an exact snapshot substitute.

New RBE gathering must not publish partial Nodes/conflict rows on a later-invalid reference or a mid-batch edit. Request batching must not produce a partial new request/metadata. Restore valid inputs and retry the same public interface to prove failed state was not retained.

Do not hoist required work outside the measured whole public call, retain contexts across request/direct-write seams, trust mutable returned sets, or drop per-reference native CAD membership classification. Caching a valid entity within a batch is only safe while exact geometry/provenance and selector fences still hold.
